versions.changelog:
AI Necklace Designer skill initial release.

- Generate jewelry design sheets, multi-view hand-drawn sketches, and interactive 3D necklace models from prompts and reference images.
- Customize necklace designs using various gemstones, metals, and materials.
- Supports a range of jewelry types, including bracelets, rings, necklaces, earrings, pet collars, and body chains.
- Provides a REST API via the OneKey Agent Gateway; usage requires the DEEPNLP_ONEKEY_ROUTER_ACCESS key.
- Includes online apps and demo links for viewing and customizing jewelry designs.
